name: EF EnergyFunders Ventures, Inc.
summary: EF EnergyFunders Ventures, Inc. operates as an energy and mineral exploration firm. Its primary activities involve the acquisition, exploration, and development of oil and gas assets across both Canada and the United States. Notably, the company maintains a significant 50% interest in Alberta's Joffre D-3 B Oil Pool. Furthermore, it actively develops and extracts oil and gas reserves within Texas, specifically in Polk and Tyler counties. Beyond its core energy ventures, EF EnergyFunders Ventures, Inc. also provides a financial technology (fintech) platform. This entity, originally established in 1945, formerly traded as Paleo Resources, Inc. before rebranding to its current name in March 2022. Its corporate headquarters are located in San Antonio, Texas.
